stateMachine.migration: authority callers use explicit definition revision and expected state/revision fencing

agenticRegistry.migration: authority callers require explicit recordedAt, revision CAS and validAt/knownAt semantics

graphRagProjection.migration: authority writes use complete atomic versioned projections; legacy incremental mutation is shadow only

contextPack.migration: authority packs require explicit asOf/knownAt/generatedAt plus projection version/hash and SHA-256 integrity

hubRepositoryRuntime.migration: authority history separates command and recorded outcome; replay applies outcomes rather than re-deciding commands

hubQueries.migration: authority queries require explicit asOf and knownAt

hubContextProjection.migration: project topology is filtered in AgenticRegistry, GraphRAG and ContextPack layers

hubSnapshotRecovery.migration: repository runtime recovery only; external agentic/memory/knowledge domains retain separate recovery contracts

memory.migration: authority reads require asOf+knownAt and append-only revision history; systemUntil is derived, never back-written

knowledge.migration: authority knowledge uses append-only system revisions, independent valid-time intervals and a rebuildable graph projection; projection failure is an explicit degraded saga state

sideEffectOperations.rule: provider exceptions and crash windows after executing require provider/resource reconciliation; no exactly-once provider-effect claim is authorized

leasesAndFencing.rule: monotonic fencing is validated at explicit prepare/begin/commit operation time; stale owners fail closed

policy.rule: default deny, exact project/sensitivity scope and exact-operation approval; policy is evaluated at every mutation boundary

agentRun.rule: append-only goal/plan/result revisions; completion requires accepted critical steps and exact evaluator/version evidence

httpIsolation.rule: host/method/port policy, public-address-only DNS pinning, TTL and redirect reauthorization; authority transport must consume pinned addresses directly

filesystemIsolation.rule: lexical defense plus broker-opened opaque handle, canonical root containment and explicit symlink policy; authority code must not reopen paths

rules: legacy direct tools are removed from the authority registry
every authority provider tool implements a preflight contract
preflight occurs before operation execution begins
read calls require policy and cannot use mutation-permission tools
mutation calls require policy, durable operation claim, active lease/fence and provider idempotency key
exceptions after begin become reconciliation_required and are never blind-retried
committed operation retries return durable results without a second provider call
agent-run evidence is appended only after accepted commit; cross-store evidence failure remains repairable and cannot rewrite provider truth
remaining: real pinned HTTP transport with TLS SNI/Host preservation
trusted runtime binding of isolation evaluation time
package-root promotion and alternate-path enforcement in Phase 07

durableEvents.migration: EventBus is delivery/observation only; durable adapters share payload-bound logical-event equality and canonical JSON wire versioning

canonicalPersistenceWire.rule: optional undefined object properties are omitted before persistence; undefined array/root values and unsupported JS objects fail closed

observability.rule: observer failure cannot change protected operation outcome; policy/lease/isolation/agent-run signal integration remains incomplete
